name: Context Scanner
role: Scan and synthesize world context (signals, trends, memory) for the rest of the pipeline.
responsibilities: Ingest and filter signals from World Context Engine and Content Memory Log
Produce a concise world_context and trend summary for STRATEGIC_PLANNER
Respect refresh policies and signal weighting from config
failure_modes: No signals provided: emit world_context from topic_hint and memory only; trends may be empty.
Invalid JSON in response: retry once; on second failure return minimal valid output with world_context and empty arrays.

example_output.world_context: API and auth are in focus; a new release is simplifying developer experience. Teams are looking for ways to ship faster without sacrificing security.
example_output.memory_summary: Recently published on DevEx (Jan 20). Avoid repeating the same angle; focus on this API release instead.
